data.description:
## Description
**What**: Add a migration-class detection step to /dso:implementation-plan's contextual discovery that classifies a story as sweep (targeted-symbol call-site repetition above a configurable threshold), db (schema/migration file patterns), or inconclusive, and persists a structured migration-class marker in the plan header.
**Why**: The marker is the spine the rest of the epic consumes — task-pair emission (sibling stories), sprint two-pass ordering, and the E2E fixture all bind to it.
**Scope**:
- IN: detection query over call sites; dual sub-classifier (sweep/db); configurable threshold; persisted marker with explicit schema; sg-unavailable degradation.
- OUT: emitting the migration task pairs (separate stories); sprint scheduling.

## Done Definitions
- When run against a story whose targeted symbol repeats at or above the threshold, the plan header records a migration-class:sweep marker
  ← Satisfies: sc-1  (sc-1: migration-class detection + persisted marker)
- When run against a story touching schema/migration file patterns (migrations/, alembic/, db/migrate, *.migration.ts, schema.sql), the plan header records a migration-class:db marker regardless of call-site count
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- Call-site counting tallies only the specifically targeted symbol or API and excludes surrounding boilerplate, imports, and test files
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- The sweep repetition threshold is read from config key migration.call_site_threshold with a documented default, and a test overriding the config moves a borderline target across the classification boundary
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- The persisted marker includes the detection query string, and a test asserts the query is retrievable from the marker after persistence
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- Classification persists the marker without emitting a user-confirmation prompt, asserted by a non-interactive test
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- When sg is unavailable the plan header records an explicit migration-class:inconclusive marker (never silently false) and the planner does not crash
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic
  ← Satisfies: sc-1

## Considerations
- [Maintainability] The persisted migration-class marker is a contract consumed by the sprint two-pass story (reads, does not recompute) and the E2E fixture story (asserts marker shape). Define the marker schema explicitly here — fields: migration-class value (sweep|db|inconclusive), detection query, threshold used, target symbol — so consumers bind to a stable shape.
- [Performance] ast-grep call-site counting on large consuming-project codebases — consider scope/timeout behavior.

## Escalation Policy
**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a planner, I auto-classify migration-class stories and persist a durable marker
